questions.prompt: How many keys does a standard full-size piano have?
questions.explanation: The standard full-size piano keyboard has 88 keys.

questions.prompt: How many strings does a standard violin have?
questions.explanation: A standard violin has four strings.

questions.prompt: How many strings does a standard acoustic guitar have?
questions.explanation: The usual acoustic guitar has six strings.

questions.prompt: Which brass instrument uses a long sliding tube to change notes?
questions.explanation: A trombone's slide changes the length of its air column.

questions.prompt: How many valves does a standard trumpet have?
questions.explanation: Most standard trumpets use three valves.

questions.prompt: What kind of reed does a clarinet use?
questions.explanation: One reed vibrates against the clarinet's mouthpiece.

questions.prompt: What kind of reed does an oboe use?
questions.explanation: An oboe uses two reed blades joined together.

questions.prompt: Which orchestra family includes the flute?
questions.explanation: The flute belongs to the woodwind family.

questions.prompt: How many lines are on a standard music staff?
questions.explanation: A standard staff uses five horizontal lines.

questions.prompt: The treble clef is also named after which note?
questions.explanation: The treble clef is also called the G clef.

questions.prompt: The bass clef is also named after which note?
questions.explanation: The bass clef is also called the F clef.

questions.prompt: What does a sharp sign do to a note's pitch?
questions.explanation: A sharp raises the note by one half step.

questions.prompt: What does a flat sign do to a note's pitch?
questions.explanation: A flat lowers the note by one half step.

questions.prompt: Which sign restores a sharpened or flattened note to its unaltered pitch?
questions.explanation: A natural restores the note's unaltered pitch.

questions.prompt: One whole note lasts as long as how many quarter notes?
questions.explanation: Four quarter-note durations equal one whole-note duration.

questions.prompt: One half note lasts as long as how many quarter notes?
questions.explanation: Two quarter-note durations equal one half-note duration.

questions.prompt: What does a rest indicate in a musical part?
questions.explanation: A rest marks a period when that part is silent.

questions.prompt: What does one dot after a note do to its duration?
questions.explanation: A dotted note lasts one-and-a-half times its original value.

questions.prompt: Which mark joins same-pitch notes into one longer sound?
questions.explanation: A tie combines the durations of notes at the same pitch.

questions.prompt: Which is the highest-pitched string in standard violin tuning?
questions.explanation: The violin strings run from low G up to high E.
